extensions.source: public/redesign.css; scripts/apply-redesign.mjs reapplies the design to current HTML; scripts/apply-technical-seo.mjs integrates it and preserves @font-face while bundling one CSS file. scripts/generate-site.mjs restores service final-form before content generation. Retained base CSS and DOM remain part of the main site.
extensions.scope: Main site implementation: 16 commercial layouts in four languages; shared skin on 41 HTML pages. Owner explicitly authorized commit, push and publication through existing GitHub main / Cloudflare Pages integration; separate local preview remains available. scripts/check-redesign-release.mjs guards 41 pages against pre-redesign c1be176 and unchanged protected JavaScript/API. Authorization does not establish completed deployment or production PageSpeed scores, and does not alter component-review receipts or formal build state.

narrative.overview: The implemented direction is a clear local technical service with direct contact and two entries: a fault or planned setup. White surfaces, dark blue headings, cobalt actions, fine dividers and restrained task surfaces carry that direction. These descriptions record the existing implementation; they do not introduce an additional creative approval.
keyCharacteristics: Light homepage and compact dark service introduction.
Flat sections, thin dividers and selectively rounded task/contact surfaces.
Local font files and technically illustrative equipment imagery.

rules.name: The Action Rule
rules.body: Keep cobalt associated with actionable contact, navigation and selection feedback; retain dark ink for the reading hierarchy.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Use tonal grouping and dividers for these implemented surfaces. Do not reintroduce lifted card shadows into their replacement styles.

dos: Do extend the actual CSS palette and geometry recorded here when working on the main site.
Do preserve four-language routes, factual content, SEO metadata, canonical/hreflang, H1, structured data, prices, reviews and districts.
Do preserve form IDs, field names, intent data attributes, contact launcher, consent and measurement contracts while moving visual wrappers.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and honor reduced motion.
Do describe the equipment photo as illustrative and retain all four shipping provenance sidecars.
donts: Don't infer new services, hardware-repair promises, guarantees, ratings or case-study evidence from the visual treatment.
Don't treat the separate local preview's mock delivery behavior as the main site's delivery contract.
Don't equate these documentation files with a component-review receipt, completed build gate, final review verdict, completed deployment or production PageSpeed certification.
Don't replace retained acquisition behavior with visually similar inert controls.
